summary.headline: Judgments on Brothers and Sisters
summary.text: Astrological judgments on brothers and sisters: fertile, barren, and intermediate signs; combustion and planetary conditions indicating many or few siblings, maternal or paternal descent, fraternal agreement, and the destruction or death of earlier brothers.
